summary: Read-only access to stored pre-10.1 qlog geometry in kommu_maps. Lane and road-edge points are modelV2 samples at x=1 metre.

shared_rules.segment_rule: A segment is inside a bbox when its first usable GPS fix (origin_lat, origin_lon) falls inside. status must be done.

endpoints.purpose: Process check. Returns no map data.
This document. It describes the token header and never contains the token.
Count stored data whose segment origin falls in the box.
List drives inside a box so a client can request one route at a time.
One drive as a FeatureCollection in schema kommu.maps.visualization-point-cloud version 1. Lookup is by dongle and route, which uses the segment index.

query.layers: optional comma list. Default vehicle_pose,lane_point,edge_point. gps_point is optional.
query.after_seg: optional segment number. Return later segments only.

feature_layers.vehicle_pose: Car position for one model frame.
feature_layers.lane_point: Lane line at x=1 m. lane_index 0 and 1 are the left side, 2 and 3 the right side.
feature_layers.edge_point: Road edge at x=1 m. edge_index 0 is the left edge and 1 is the right edge.
feature_layers.gps_point: GPS fix from gpsLocation or gpsLocationExternal.

endpoints.paging: When the drive does not fit in max_features, metadata.truncated is true and metadata.next_after_seg is the last segment included. Repeat the request with after_seg set to that value.
endpoints.geometry: Point coordinates are [longitude, latitude] in EPSG:4326.

errors.401: Missing or wrong bearer token on a /v1/ path.
errors.404: No stored done segments for that dongle and route.
